Title: Wire Data 2.0 (preview) will be retired on 31 March 2022

Body.Content:
Because Azure Monitor Virtual Machine insights and Service Map both provide network connection data sets in Logs, utilize the Dependency agent, and have connections with Azure Sentinel, we will be retiring Wire Data 2.0 (preview) on 31 March 2022. Please transition to using Azure Monitor Virtual Machine insights or Service Map by that date.

We encourage you to make the switch sooner to gain the richer benefits of Azure Monitor Virtual Machine insights. In addition to current features you already use, Azure Monitor Virtual Machine insights provides:

  • Network dependency visualizations
  • Workbooks for analyzing network connections
  • Performance data sets and analysis
  • VM health monitors

Action required

To avoid or minimize disruption to your network connection monitoring and analysis, transition to Azure Monitor Virtual Machine insights before 31 March 2022.

More Information

If you have questions, you may refer to the guidance in the Wire Data 2.0 (preview) documentation and get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
